title: Three-Dimensional Particle Trajectory and Landing Location
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A particle experiences acceleration a(t) = <2, 0, -32> with initial velocity v(0) = <0, 10, 64> and initial position r(0) = <0, 0, 0>. Find the landing location when the particle returns to z = 0.

steps.title: Integrate for Velocity Vector
steps.explanation: Integrate acceleration components and apply initial velocity v(0) = <0, 10, 64>.

steps.title: Integrate for Position Vector
steps.explanation: Integrate velocity components with initial condition r(0) = 0.

steps.title: Solve for Landing Time and Position
steps.explanation: Find positive root of z(t) = 0 and evaluate x(4) and y(4).
